the copper pour came 0.0513mm from other-net copper against a 0.15mm floor (nearest: pcb_smtpad_152); 18 boundary vertices pushed back, worst gap now 0.2053mm. A pour cuts a 32-gon around each obstacle and a via obeys none of the pour's margin props, so the shortfall is structural rather than this board's
J1 sits 0.349mm from the board edge; the assembly line grips the outer 2.5mm and needs 1mm as an absolute floor
U3 sits exactly on the 0.4mm pitch floor — legal, with no margin for a footprint revision

7 part(s) are in package families whose zero-rotation convention differs between EDA output and JLCPCB's library: J1, LED1, LED2, U1, U2, U4, Y1. Check pin-1 on each in the placement preview before paying — that screen is the only place this is catchable
USB_DP_CONN routes 22.02mm and USB_DM_CONN 16.15mm — 5.87mm of intra-pair skew against a 3.8mm budget (USB 2.0, ~150ps on FR-4). Length-match the pair or shorten the longer leg

USB_DP_CONN/USB_DM_CONN run within 0.60mm of each other (4x the 0.15mm trace) for only 39% of the run — a differential pair should travel together (widest gap 3.47mm). The pipeline's pair pass (circuitpy.diffpair) either could not route this pair or was switched off; its report says which. Review the pair before ordering

4% of USB_DP's run has ground copper on the opposite layer within 0.5mm. A differential pair needs a continuous return path under it or its impedance is undefined and its return current goes wherever it can. Pour ground on the free layer under the pair

7% of USB_DP_CONN's run has ground copper on the opposite layer within 0.5mm. A differential pair needs a continuous return path under it or its impedance is undefined and its return current goes wherever it can. Pour ground on the free layer under the pair
U2's nearest decoupling capacitor to pin VIN is 9.7mm away; the loop inductance is what does the work, so keep it inside 5mm (1 pin(s) are further)
U3's nearest decoupling capacitor to pin IOVDD3 is 6.1mm away; the loop inductance is what does the work, so keep it inside 5mm (2 pin(s) are further)
2 signal(s) leave the board through J1 with no ESD clamp on them (J1.A5, J1.B5). A finger on a connector is several kilovolts
1 rail(s) have nowhere to put a probe (V3_3). Add a test point — nobody can diagnose a dead board over chat without one
U2 dissipates 0.23W at 134mA and sits about 59 degC junction, 66 degC inside the limit
